# P5.8 Seller contract fixtures

These JSON files are real response bodies produced by Core's internal Seller
HTTP handlers. They were generated by Core's `TestP58SellerContractShapes`
handler test (internal/coreapi/seller_catalog_contract_test.go) and are pinned
to the Core commit recorded in `CORE_SHA.txt`.

They are the source of truth for the response DTOs in
`internal/coreclient/catalog_orders.go`. `contract_test.go` in that package
decodes every fixture and asserts the key contract fields survive. When Core's
contract changes, regenerate the fixtures from the updated Core test and update
the DTOs and `CORE_SHA.txt` together.

Files:

- `product-list.json` — GET /internal/v1/stores/{storeID}/products (list page envelope with embedded per-row inventory summary)
- `product-detail.json` — GET/POST/PUT product detail (category_ids, current_price money object, aggregate inventory_summary)
- `locations.json` — GET /internal/v1/stores/{storeID}/locations (`{"locations":[...]}` envelope)
- `location.json` — POST /internal/v1/stores/{storeID}/locations (single location, `location_type` field)
- `inventory.json` — GET /internal/v1/stores/{storeID}/inventory (`{"inventory":[...]}` envelope with enriched rows: id, location_name, available_qty, version)
- `media-presign.json` — POST .../media/uploads (upload_url, storage_key, upload_token, expires_at)
- `media-complete.json` — POST .../media (media metadata with storage_key and updated_at)
- `presentation.json` — GET/PUT .../listings/{listingID}/presentation
- `order-detail.json` — GET /internal/v1/stores/{storeID}/orders/{orderID} (safe seller shape: contact_email, timeline, allowed_next_actions, order-level currency)
- `order-transition.json` — POST .../orders/{orderID}/transition (same detail shape after the transition)
